title: Slash section heading
description: A large high-contrast serif heading (88, 64 or 52px on desktop, 36px on phones) with one run set in italic, tight lines, and a soft grey sub-line under it; centred or left-aligned.
notes: needs a display serif with a real italic (font-display)
name: slash-heading

props.name: parts
props.description: the heading, as runs; `{ italic: "strong" }` sets a run in italic

props.name: align
props.description: centred (product sections) or left (customers, pricing, FAQ)

props.name: headingClassName
props.description: extra classes on the heading itself (e.g. a max width that sets the line break)
